Use case: production transparent character rig atlas for a mobile isometric raid strategy game. Create EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, 18 DISCONNECTED body parts on real transparent alpha, landscape 1536x1024. Equal cells 256x341, generous empty alpha gutters, all pieces entirely inside their own cells. No text, labels, shadows on background, complete characters, weapons, or extra pieces. Every piece is upright. Upper arms and forearms point straight DOWN with proximal joint at top and distal joint at bottom. Thighs vertical, shins include boots. All pieces belong to expressive heroic cartoon characters, 3/4 FRONT view facing right, viewed from an elevated isometric camera at 30 degrees. Professional sculpted 3D-painted volumes, premium Clash of Clans-like mobile game art direction, strong readable shapes and large clean color regions, warm upper-left light, matte skin, softly bevelled gear, no realistic skin pores, no photorealism, no ornate filigree or gold jewelry noise, no thin fragile limbs, no Lego or Playmobil appearance. ORIGINAL character identities. Consistent lighting, scale and proportions across each row. They will be seen only 45 pixels tall when assembled, so prioritize bold contrast and clean silhouettes over fine engraving.
COLUMNS, left to right, exactly: (1) HEAD including neck only; (2) TORSO shoulders-to-hips including waist belt and short tunic hem, no head or arms or legs; (3) ONE UPPER ARM shoulder-to-elbow; (4) ONE FOREARM elbow-to-fist, fingers curled to grip a weapon; (5) ONE THIGH hip-to-knee; (6) ONE SHIN knee-to-boot, a single chunky boot included. Separate rounded joint ends must overlap seamlessly when rigged. No paired limbs.
ROW 1: powerful sun-raider warrior, big square expressive tan face, swept copper-blond hair, thick dark eyebrows, short copper beard, determined grin, no helmet. Muscular bare chest with ONE broad brown leather diagonal strap, thick brown belt, simple brass buckle, short dark red leather battle kilt. Large bare muscular upper arm with one plain brass armband. Muscular forearm, brown leather wrist bracer and strong tan gripping hand. Thick bare tan thigh partially covered at upper end by red kilt edge. Sturdy brown leather shin guard and wide brown boot with one brass buckle. Heroic chunky athletic build, broad shoulder volumes and readable flesh color; not a realistic bodybuilder.
ROW 2: focused young woodland archer, large expressive green eyes, vivid plum-magenta bob haircut with side-swept fringe, small green hood resting at back of head. Emerald green short leather tunic with simple brown belt and pale green trim, no metal armor or shoulder pads. Slender but sturdy bare tan upper arm with small green fabric shoulder cuff. Brown wrist bracer and bare gripping hand on forearm. Bare tan thigh with a small dark green shorts edge at top. Brown knee-high leather boot on lower leg. Clear vibrant green and magenta blocks, no jewelry, no elf ears.
ROW 3: determined adult battle mage, strong eyebrows, olive skin and short dark brown pointed goatee, deep cobalt blue hood framing face, no white beard, no elderly face. Deep blue tunic torso with a simple brown waist belt, modest pale gold edge and short split robe hem ending at hips. Broad blue cloth sleeve upper arm. Blue cuff forearm with bare olive gripping hand. Dark blue cloth thigh. Dark brown boot with blue shin fabric. Strong blue silhouette with clear face, no ornate armor.
18 separate assets, 6 columns 3 rows, no full bodies. Each part fills about 70 percent of its cell, centered with large transparent gutters. Complete objects, not cropped. These are game animation assets, not an infographic.

This input is the FRONT-view modular sprite atlas for Valdoria. Make its matching REAR-view animation atlas. Preserve the exact six-column, three-row layout, spacing, item sizes, color palette, character identities, materials, and simple polished sculpted 3D cartoon rendering. TRUE transparent alpha background. No backdrop, no text or labels, no complete bodies, no weapons. Each piece stays upright and disconnected in the corresponding cell. View every piece from an elevated 3/4 BACK view facing away toward the UPPER RIGHT. In column one show only BACKS of heads and necks: back of copper-blond hair for the muscular warrior, green hood with magenta hair tips for the archer, cobalt blue hood for the mage. NO FACES. Column two BACKS of torsos with matching straps/belts, no arms or heads. Other columns one upper arm shoulder-to-elbow, one forearm elbow-to-gripping-fist, one thigh hip-to-knee, one shin plus boot. Arms hang downward as in input, proximal joint at top, distal joint at bottom. Row1 tan muscular warrior, simple leather strap on bare back, brown belt and dark red leather kilt, plain brass armband and leather bracer, brown boots. Row2 green tunic archer, bare tan arms and thighs, brown bracers and boots. Row3 blue hooded mage, simple gold trim and brown belt, blue cloth sleeves and thighs, brown boots. Match the exact 1536x1024 grid, 18 parts, large clean transparent gutters. Crisp clean broad colors and readable volumes for 45-pixel-tall assembled game characters. Do not introduce filigree, fine ornamental details, metallic armor, extra items or front-view faces.

Production game equipment sprite atlas for Valdoria, a richly rendered stylized isometric mobile fantasy strategy game, visually polished like premium Clash of Clans style game props but original designs. EXACTLY SIX isolated equipment assets in a clean THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Canvas landscape 1536x1024. Each asset fits wholly inside its equal cell with generous transparent margins, no object crosses a cell boundary. No characters, no hands, no text, no labels, no backdrop, no cast ground shadow. Sculpted readable large shapes, rounded bevels, warm upper-left lighting, strong ambient occlusion, rich navy blue and warm brass, crisply painted 3D volumes; NOT flat icons, NOT line drawings, NOT photoreal. Camera almost front-on to each item, very slight three-quarter turn for depth, all long items upright vertical.
TOP LEFT: broad royal navy enamel heater shield, brass rim, three-dimensional golden sun emblem in center, subtly curved face, visible thick edge, whole shield upright. TOP MIDDLE: stout steel broadsword upright pointing up, wide beveled sharp blade, bright blade ridge, brass crossguard, brown wrapped grip and small brass pommel at bottom; the steel blade covers the upper 70 percent of total length. TOP RIGHT: elegant wooden recurved bow upright, open shape curving to the RIGHT, carved wood, leather-wrapped central grip, brass capped tips. Absolutely NO bow string, NO arrow, NO hands; the string must be added by the engine.
BOTTOM LEFT: brown leather quiver upright with three ivory feathered arrows sticking out, straps, brass studs and a small green panel, whole object isolated. BOTTOM MIDDLE: wooden mage staff upright, straight narrow carved brown shaft, small gold cradle at the very top holding a luminous cyan faceted crystal, crisp facets not a blown-out glow, whole staff isolated. BOTTOM RIGHT: compact fire magic orb hovering by itself, fiery orange core, curled flame wisps, yellow center, tight silhouette and soft tiny surrounding glow. Each of the six props must be fully detached, transparent pixels between all cells. They are real game sprites to be used over a green battlefield, no diagrams, no fake checkerboard background.
